section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that being in the seventh generation, though not by choice, is beloved because it is the era of the heels of Moshiach, tasked with completing the drawing down of the Shechinah, specifically the essence of the Shechinah, into the lower realms.
section.t: And behold, this is demanded of each and every one of us, the seventh generation,
for all sevenths are beloved,
for even though that we are in the seventh generation is not according to our choice nor through our service,
and in many matters it may be not according to our will,
nevertheless, all sevenths are beloved,
for we find ourselves in the heels of Moshiach,
at the very end of the heels,
and the service is to complete the drawing down of the Shechinah,
and not just the Shechinah, but the essence of the Shechinah,
and specifically in the lower realms.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section discusses that after explaining the essence of the Shechinah was originally in the lower realms and Moshe drew it down to the land, the main revelation of G-dliness was in the Holy Temple, as it says "Make Me a Sanctuary and I will dwell within them," and this is also the meaning of "the righteous shall inherit the land," for they draw down the aspect of the Eternal Dweller.
section.t: d)
And behold, after the maamar explains that the essence of the Shechinah was in the lower realms and also afterwards Moshe drew it down
(the seventh)
specifically to the land, it says: And the main revelation of G-dliness was in the Holy Temple
(and brings on this the verse)
as it is written4
"And they shall make Me a Sanctuary and I will dwell in their midst,"
it does not say "in it" but rather "in their midst," within each and every one of Israel14,
and this is
(also what is written15)
"The righteous shall inherit the land and dwell upon it forever," that the righteous shall inherit the land which is Gan Eden,
because they cause to dwell
(meaning they draw down16)
the aspect of "He Who dwells forever, exalted and holy"17
(this matter of "He Who dwells forever" is not explained in the maamar,
and it is explained in Likkutei Torah18
based on a statement of the Zohar19)
that it will be revealed below,
and this is "I have come to My garden, to My orchard," to the place which was its main place initially, for the essence of the Shechinah was in the lower realms.
And the matter is
(an explanation of the matter to understand why the essence of the Shechinah was specifically in the lower realms)
that behold, the ultimate intent of the creation and the chain of descent of the worlds,
is that the Holy One, blessed be He, desired to have for Himself a dwelling place in the lower realms20.

section.sectionSummaryBrief: This section explains that the ultimate purpose of the chain of descent is not for the higher worlds, as they are a descent from His light, but for this lowly world, where the creation feels its existence is from its own essence, and through service of subjugation and transformation, the Awtsmoos is revealed.
section.t: And behold, our master the Alter Rebbe explains in Tanya that
the ultimate purpose of the chain of descent of the worlds and their descent is not for the sake of the higher worlds,
since for them it is a descent from the light of His countenance,
and it is impossible to say that the intent is for the sake of the descent.
For behold, it is known that creation is only through the power of the Awtsmoos,
and as it is written in Iggeret HaKodesh, beginning "He and His life"21
that His Essence and Selfhood, whose existence is from His own selfhood and has no preceding cause, Heaven forbid,
He alone, in His power and ability, creates something from nothing and absolute non-existence.
That is, the coming into being is not from the revelations but from the Awtsmoos,
and if so, it is impossible to say that the purpose of the coming into being is for the sake of the higher worlds,
for even the world of Atzilus is a revelation of the concealment22
and thus it is a descent from the light of His countenance,
for when the lights of Atzilus were in their concealment, they were on a much higher level.
And furthermore, since this is only their revelations, it is impossible that the Awtsmoos is for the sake of its revelations,
but rather the purpose is this lowly world.
And as the Mitteler Rebbe said in the portion Zoi
(Parshat Beshalach)
regarding the difference between the higher worlds and this world,
that in this world it is felt that its existence is from its own selfhood
(and as explained in the continuation of Rosh HaShanah of this year23,
the difference between a created being and light,
for light is evidence of the luminary,
for when we see light,
the light itself shows and reveals that there is a luminary,
but not so a created being; not only does it not reveal the Creator,
but furthermore, it conceals and hides Him,
and on the contrary, it is felt that its existence is from its own selfhood
(except that from the perspective of intellect it is forced that it is not so)24).
And even though this is only in its feeling,
nevertheless, this very thing, that it at least appears that its existence is from its own selfhood, is because its root is from the Awtsmoos, whose existence is from its own selfhood.
Thus it is understood that the intent in creation and the chain of descent is not for the sake of the higher worlds, whose matter is revelations,
but rather the intent is this lowly world,
which appears to itself not as a revelation but as selfhood,
that is, its existence is from its own selfhood,
and through the service in it,
through subjugation and transformation,
the Awtsmoos is revealed,
for its sake was the creation and chain of descent of the worlds.
